# Function history fixtures

`functions.asm` exercises a completed helper call before entering `emit`, several
global entry labels in one optional region, and an unused optional block.

Artifacts:

- `functions.elf`: direct-ROM debug companion; three retained regions.
- `functions-linked.elf`: linked object with section garbage collection; three
  live regions and retained tombstoned metadata for `unused`.

Regenerate from `C:/Work/Programming/v6vscode/test/fixtures/asmdbg` with the updated
v6asm and V6C linker on PATH:

```powershell
v6asm -g functions.asm -o functions.rom
v6asm -g -f obj functions.asm -o functions.o
ld.lld -m elf32v6clang --gc-sections -e main -Ttext=0x100 functions.o -o functions-linked.elf
llvm-objcopy -O binary functions-linked.elf functions-linked.rom
```

Producer source revisions before this feature: v6asm `cd339f7`, v6clang `899e3cb`.
These artifacts include the working-tree v6asm function metadata additions.
Live acceptance uses v6emul `7ff0e60` plus its history API additions.
ROMs are generated by the existing fixture helper in test runs. The object is a
regeneration intermediate; the two small ELF consumer snapshots are checked in.

Metadata schema: vendor region tag `0x4080`, standard entry-point children, vendor
inline source path `0x3f01`; see the v6asm metadata documentation. Emulator API:
function history schema 1, commands 111 and 112.
